name: phylogenetics
description: Real local phylogenetics pipeline: DNA QC, progressive pairwise-aligner MSA, neighbor-joining tree and reproducible report (Biopython).

tools.description: Parse FASTA with the existing smartbio parser; require at least three unique, non-empty DNA sequences of at least 50 bp. Fails closed.

references.title: Biopython: freely available Python tools for computational molecular biology and bioinformatics

limitations: Validation accepts the IUPAC DNA alphabet; ambiguous bases are not resolved into a single nucleotide.
Length and alphabet checks cannot assess sequencing quality or contamination.
Research use only; this is not a clinical diagnostic result.

tools.description: Deterministic progressive multiple sequence alignment: UPGMA guide tree from real pairwise-aligner identity distances, then consensus-driven profile merges with Bio.Align.PairwiseAligner (match +2, mismatch -1, gap open -5, gap extend -2).

references.title: Biopython: freely available Python tools for computational molecular biology and bioinformatics
CLUSTAL W: improving the sensitivity of progressive multiple sequence alignment

limitations: Progressive multiple sequence alignment is a heuristic and does not guarantee a global optimum.
The guide tree depends on the fixed scoring scheme; alternative scores may produce a different alignment.
Conserved columns are counted only where every sequence shares the same non-gap residue.

tools.description: Real neighbor-joining tree from Biopython identity distances (DistanceCalculator + DistanceTreeConstructor), emitted as Newick, deterministic SVG and validated statistics.

references.title: Biopython: freely available Python tools for computational molecular biology and bioinformatics
The neighbor-joining method: a new method for reconstructing phylogenetic trees

limitations: Neighbor joining is a distance-based heuristic, not a maximum-likelihood or Bayesian inference.
The identity distance model ignores substitution saturation and rate variation.
An unrooted NJ tree is stored with a trifurcating root; internal branches are hypotheses, not proof of ancestry.
